postpone the meeting: Because the manager is sick today, we have to postpone the meeting until next Monday afternoon.
因為經理今天生病，我們必須把會議延後到下週一下午。
postpone a decision: You don't have to choose a university right now; it's fine to postpone a decision until you get your test scores.
你不必現在就選大學；延後決定，等拿到考試成績再說也沒關係。
be postponed until: Because of the heavy typhoon rain, the school sports day will be postponed until next Friday.
由於颱風帶來大雨，學校運動會將延至下週五舉行。
pour money into: The city plans to pour money into new parks and bike lanes to make the downtown area greener.
市政府打算砸錢投入新公園和自行車道，讓市中心更綠化。
pour out one's heart: After the breakup, Amy called her best friend and began to pour out her heart for nearly two hours.
分手後，艾美打電話給她最好的朋友，傾吐心聲將近兩個小時。
pour cold water on: I was excited about starting a band, but my dad poured cold water on the idea, saying I should study instead.
我對組樂團很興奮，但我爸對這個想法潑冷水，說我應該去讀書。
people poured in: As soon as the department store opened its doors for the big sale, people poured in to grab the best deals.
百貨公司一開門舉行大拍賣，人潮就湧入搶購最划算的商品。
pour scorn on: Some critics poured scorn on the young writer's first novel, but readers loved it and bought thousands of copies.
有些評論家對這位年輕作家的第一本小說大加嘲諷，但讀者很喜愛，買了好幾千本。
it never rains but it pours: First I lost my wallet, and then my phone broke; it never rains but it pours, I guess.
先是我弄丟了錢包，接著手機又壞了；我想這真是禍不單行。
power the engine: A small battery is enough to power the engine of this toy car for about two hours.
一顆小電池就足以驅動這台玩具車的引擎大約兩個小時。
be powered by: The new city buses are powered by electricity, so they are much quieter and cleaner than the old ones.
新的市區公車由電力驅動，所以比舊公車安靜又乾淨得多。
power through the work: Even though she felt tired, Lisa drank some coffee and decided to power through the work before midnight.
雖然覺得很累，麗莎還是喝了點咖啡，決定在午夜前硬撐完成工作。
power up: Please power up your laptops and log in to the school website before the lesson begins.
上課開始前，請把筆電開機並登入學校網站。
practice law: After passing the difficult bar exam, my cousin began to practice law at a small firm in Taipei.
通過困難的律師考試後，我表哥開始在台北一家小事務所執業當律師。
practice what you preach: If you tell your kids not to use their phones at dinner, you should practice what you preach.
如果你叫孩子吃晚餐時不要用手機，你自己就應該言行一致。
practice medicine: Doctors from other countries must pass a local exam before they are allowed to practice medicine in Taiwan.
外國醫生必須通過本地考試，才能獲准在台灣行醫。
practice self-control: When you feel angry with a classmate, try to practice self-control and take a deep breath before speaking.
當你對同學感到生氣時，試著練習自制，說話前先深呼吸。
practice a religion: In a free country, people have the right to practice a religion without fear of being punished.
在自由的國家，人們有權信奉宗教而不必害怕受到懲罰。
put into practice: You learned many useful study skills this term, so try to put them into practice when preparing for the final exam.
你這學期學了很多有用的讀書技巧，所以準備期末考時試著把它們付諸實行。
praise someone for: Mom praised me for cleaning my room without being asked, and she even gave me a big hug.
媽媽稱讚我沒人叫就自己打掃房間，甚至給了我一個大大的擁抱。
praise highly: Our coach doesn't praise highly very often, so when he says "good job," we know we really did well.
我們教練不常高度讚揚別人，所以當他說「做得好」時，我們知道自己真的表現很好。
sing one's praises: My classmates kept singing my praises after I helped our team win the English speech contest.
在我幫助我們隊贏得英語演講比賽後，同學們一直對我大加讚揚。
praise to the skies: The fans praised the young pitcher to the skies after he struck out ten batters in his first game.
這位年輕投手在首場比賽三振了十名打者後，球迷們把他捧上天。
predict the weather: Modern computers help scientists predict the weather more accurately, so fishermen know when it is safe to go out.
現代電腦幫助科學家更準確地預測天氣，所以漁民知道何時出海是安全的。
predict the outcome: Both teams are very strong this year, so it is almost impossible to predict the outcome of the final game.
今年兩隊都非常強，所以幾乎不可能預測冠軍賽的結果。
hard to predict: Mountain weather is hard to predict, so always bring a raincoat when you go hiking.
山上的天氣難以預料，所以去爬山時一定要帶雨衣。
predict growth: Experts predict growth of about three percent in the island's economy next year because exports are rising.
由於出口增加，專家預測明年島內經濟成長約百分之三。
prejudice the outcome: The judge warned reporters that their stories about the case could prejudice the outcome of the trial.
法官警告記者，他們對這起案件的報導可能會影響審判結果的公正性。
prejudice someone against: One rude waiter was enough to prejudice my father against the whole restaurant chain for years.
一位無禮的服務生就足以使我父親多年來對整個連鎖餐廳有偏見。
without prejudice: The company offered to pay for the damage without prejudice, meaning it did not admit that it was at fault.
公司在不損及權益的前提下提議賠償損失，意思是它並不承認自己有過錯。
